messages:
Anya: Alert: private control-plane rotation in eu-west-1 appears to have caused auth failures for Private-agent heartbeats and API calls. Reports from two customers and internal monitors showing 401/403 for agent registration since 02:14 UTC. Opening incident and posting status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2839123456 :rotating_light:
Ops-Bot: Incident INC-2839123456 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/private-agent-auth-fail. Pager notified to oncall.
Leo (oncall): Acknowledged. Pulling agent logs and control-plane audit trails. Initial signal: rotation job cp-rot-2026-03 applied certs with missing CA bundle on 02:12; agents rejected with TLS auth errors and intermittent 401s.
Infra: Confirmed rotation job applied to 8/10 control-plane nodes; two nodes returned 500 during post-rotate healthcheck and were marked degraded. Rolling back rotation now and re-issuing CA bundle to affected nodes.
Anya: Mitigation plan: 1) pause any further rotations 2) rollback control-plane certs to pre-rotation snapshot 3) re-issue updated CA bundle and restart agent-registration service 4) open targeted outreach to impacted Private customers. Do this ASAP.
Leo (oncall): Paused rotation pipeline. Initiating rollback to cp-snapshot-2026-0318 at 02:22. Kicking a restart of agent-registry on nodes 2/5/7 after rollback.
Eng-Sec: Preliminary root cause: rotation script omitted the cross-signed CA when writing the truststore for a subset of nodes; validation failed for agent tokens signed by older CA chain. We'll add an integration check to rotation pipeline.
Infra: Rollback applied to 6/6 targeted nodes so far. Early metrics: agent-auth failures dropped from ~18% -> 4.5% in 5m. Affected customer clusters are re-registering; some long-poll webhooks need manual requeue.
CS: Drafting customer notification: "We experienced brief authentication failures for Private deployments in eu-west-1 due to a control-plane certificate rotation issue. We paused rotation and rolled back; agent connectivity is recovering. Full update and RCA to follow." Approve to publish?
Marta (product): Approve. Add note that customers using on-prem bundles should re-sync if still affected and include support runbook link.
Anya: Additional mitigation: increase registration retry backoff on edge to reduce stampeding, and temporarily enable a short-lived compatibility mode accepting either CA chain during re-registration window.
Leo (oncall): Compatibility mode toggled (flag: accept-legacy-ca=true) and retry backoff applied. Observed further improvement: auth failures down to ~1.1% in 12m. Two stuck webhooks reprocessed manually.
Ops-Bot: Update INC-2839123456: rollback complete, compatibility flag enabled, monitoring. Links: logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/2839123456  ci-run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/84211
Eng-Sec: Action items: add CA-chain validation test to rotation CI, add preflight check for truststore content, and require canary rollouts to single node before fleet rotation. Creating ticket ENGSEC-452.
Infra: Next: re-run rotation in small canary after tests and manual verification; only resume full rotation after sign-off. For now rotation pipeline remains paused.
CS: Notifying impacted customers via targeted email and scheduling callbacks for any customer still reporting issues.
Anya: Customer impact summary: brief authentication disruption for Private deployments in eu-west-1; connectivity restored for most customers after rollback and compatibility window. No data loss reported. Publishing interim status and will follow up with RCA within 48h.
Marta (product): Exec one-liner: "Brief Private control-plane cert rotation caused transient agent auth failures in eu-west-1; rollback + compatibility fix restored connectivity; RCA incoming." :white_check_mark:
Leo (oncall): Continuing to monitor for 1h. If any auth rate >3% we re-open pager and escalate. Tag logs/traces with INC-2839123456 for postmortem.
Anya: Thanks team. Will update status page and close thread once stable for 1h.
